# sanity_schema (Data Source)

Reads a Sanity content schema for a workspace. Use this data source to reference an existing deployed schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the default workspace schema
data "sanity_schema" "default" {
  project_id     = "abc123"
  dataset        = "production"
  workspace_name = "default"
}

output "schema_version" {
  value = data.sanity_schema.default.version
}

output "schema_types" {
  value = data.sanity_schema.default.schema
}

# Read a tagged schema
data "sanity_schema" "next" {
  project_id     = "abc123"
  dataset        = "staging"
  workspace_name = "default"
  tag            = "next"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) The dataset name.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID.
- `workspace_name` (String) The workspace name, e.g. `default`.

### Optional

- `tag` (String) An optional tag for the schema.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The schema document ID.
- `schema` (String) The schema definition as a JSON array of type objects.
- `version` (String) The schema version.
- `workspace_title` (String) The workspace title.
